name: NewsletterCard
title: NewsletterCard
summary: A dark email sign-up card with an eyebrow, headline, one email field and a full-width Subscribe button, which turns into a one-line confirmation after sign-up.
whenToUse: Use at the end of stories, in the footer area of ism.bible and on the News page.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for giving or partner sign-up; use DonationWidget or PartnerCard.
Do not add more fields (name, country) here; a longer form belongs on its own page.

anatomy.description: `.mn-nl` (black with blue and gold glows, `--radius-lg`) → eyebrow → title → lead → field → button → note. Success (replaces field, button and note):

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called with the email after it passes validation. May return a promise: the button shows the submitting
state until it resolves (then the success line shows) and stays on the form if it rejects. No network call
is made by this component.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Force an error message state from outside (for example a server rejection).

variantNotes: Default: input on white 6% with a white 30% border; hover border white 55%; focus border `--blue-on-dark`.
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the input turns its border `--error-on-dark`; `.mn-nl-err` shows below in `--error-on-dark`; focus returns to the input.
Success: field, button and note hide; `.mn-nl-rule` (`--gradient-line`) and `.mn-nl-ok` (check in `--blue-on-dark`) appear.
Submitting: button shows `.spin` + "Subscribing…" and is disabled.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always dark (`--black` surface); add `.on-dark` so the base eyebrow, label and links switch colours.
One field, one button. Subscribe is the single Horizon Blue button, full width.
Label above the field ("Email"); the placeholder is an example, not the label.
Validate on submit, not while typing. Keep the message next to the field.
The privacy note sits under the button at 13px, with the link in `--blue-on-dark`.
Field and button are at least 44px tall.

accessibility: Real `<label for>` on the input; `type="email"` and `autocomplete="email"`.
The error is linked through `aria-describedby`; set `aria-invalid="true"` only while invalid.
The success line is `role="status"` so it is announced; move focus to it after submit.
Check contrast of the lead and note text on black (white 72% and 60% pass at these sizes).
content: Eyebrow: "Newsletter". Title: "Stories from the field, once a month."
Lead: "Answered prayers, new languages and ways to help. Short and worth reading."
Success: "You’re in. Watch for our next letter."

html:
Newsletter
